pages.text: Mom opened the box. There was a pair of new shoes inside. Pongi slipped her foot in. A perfect fit!
Pongi walked all the way around the yard. Tap, tap, tap went her shoes.
"Let's go to Grandpa Goose's." Dad walked ahead. Pongi walked along, looking down at her toes.
A wide patch of mud lay in front of the bridge. Pongi stopped in her tracks.
"Come this way and you won't get wet." Dad led the way.
Dad took a big step. Squelch!
Dad's leg sank into the mud, right up to his knee. "Uh... this isn't the right way."
Pongi took Dad's hand and pulled. One, two, three!
Dad popped out of the mud. Pongi tumbled backward.
They were both covered in mud. Pongi looked down at her new shoes. Then she smiled.
